g.mirP: Same family, same choices, same luck. Only the pay gap, the motherhood penalty and how long people live change.
h.f2p4: Women and men: life expectancy and the sex ratio at birth come from the World Bank (2023). The gender pay gap comes from the OECD (median full-time pay in Japan, the US, the UK, Germany, Mexico and Brazil), Singapore's Ministry of Manpower, Malaysia's DOSM and ILOSTAT for the rest. The motherhood penalty comes from The Child Penalty Atlas (Kleven, Landais and Leite-Mariante, 2025). China's pay gap (no official figure, so the ILO world average), Singapore's child penalty, pay gaps below zero (counted as zero) and turning the child penalty into lower pay are estimates.
